description: This file contains an abstract test runner class for verifying dependency injection integration with Orleans grains. It includes configuration for services, and multiple test methods to ensure correct DI behavior such as singleton/scoped services, grain activation, and dependency resolution.

classes.name: DependencyInjectionGrainTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing a suite of dependency injection tests for Orleans grains, including configuration and validation of DI behaviors.

methods.name: DependencyInjectionGrainTestRunner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test runner with a fixture.

methods.name: CanGetGrainWithInjectedDependencies
methods.description: Test verifying grains can be activated with constructor dependencies injected.

methods.name: CanGetGrainWithInjectedGrainFactory
methods.description: Test verifying IGrainFactory is available for injection.

methods.name: CanResolveSingletonDependencies
methods.description: Test verifying singleton services are shared across grains.

methods.name: CanResolveScopedDependencies
methods.description: Test verifying scoped services create unique instances per grain activation.

methods.name: CanResolveScopedGrainActivationContext
methods.description: Test verifying IGrainActivationContext is available as a scoped service.

methods.name: ScopedDependenciesAreThreadSafe
methods.description: Test verifying thread safety of scoped services within a grain.

methods.name: CanResolveSameDependenciesViaServiceProvider
methods.description: Test verifying services resolved via IServiceProvider match constructor-injected services.

methods.name: CanResolveSingletonGrainFactory
methods.description: Test verifying IGrainFactory is a singleton across grains.

methods.name: CannotGetExplictlyRegisteredGrain
methods.description: Test verifying explicitly registered DI grains are ignored by Orleans.

methods.name: CanUseGenericArgumentsInConstructor
methods.description: Test verifying generic grains can have dependencies injected based on type parameters.
